chunks: And from him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the one who performs Umrah during the months of Hajj, and he said, 'It is Umrat al-Mut'ah.' And it is permissible for one who performs an independent Umrah during the months of Hajj to return to his family, even if he does not perform Hajj. Narrated.

key_terms.أَشْهُرُ الْحَجِّ: The months of Hajj (Shawwal, Dhu al-Qi'dah, and first 10 days of Dhu al-Hijjah)
key_terms.عُمْرَةٌ مُفْرَدَةٌ: Independent Umrah (Umrah performed separately from Hajj)
key_terms.عُمْرَةُ الْمُتْعَةِ: Umrat al-Mut'ah, a specific type of Umrah performed during Hajj months

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for performing Umrah during the months of Hajj without performing Hajj?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that performing Umrah during the Hajj months constitutes 'Umrat al-Mut'ah' (Umrah of temporary enjoyment), a distinct ritual where the pilgrim is not bound to perform Hajj in the same year. This ruling highlights the flexibility in the Shia jurisprudence of the two pilgrimages, allowing the Umrah pilgrim to return home after completing their rites without the immediate obligation of Hajj, provided they intend it as a separate act of worship.
